info.title: IP Lookup (owner, network, country) + My IP
info.description: Who owns an IP address: network name, range, CIDR, organization, country and registration date from the Regional Internet Registries (RDAP). Without 'ip', returns the caller's IP, country, city and ASN.

parameters.name: ip
parameters.description: IPv4 or IPv6 (empty = your own IP)
